title: UI fonts: Manrope, Fraunces, Dela Gothic One (OFL)
summary: Three OFL fonts plus a helper script: Manrope variable sans (weights 200-800) for HUD text and numbers, Fraunces variable display serif (weights 100-900, optical size) for titles, Dela Gothic One heavy poster face for arcade titles and big numbers.
use_when: Any game with on-screen text: titles, HUD numbers, buttons, dialogue. Required by ui-kit-core, ui-juice, ui-cinematic and ui-horror.
how_to_use: In code: const Fonts := preload("res://starter/ui-fonts/fonts.gd"); label.add_theme_font_override("font", Fonts.sans(800)) (Manrope extra bold) or Fonts.display(700) (Fraunces bold) or Fonts.poster() (Dela Gothic One). Fonts.label(text, size, color, font, outline_px) returns a ready Label. In scenes or Themes, the .ttf files load directly as FontFile (res://starter/ui-fonts/Manrope.ttf). Variable weights only through FontVariation (the helper does it). Keep the *-OFL.txt files next to the fonts.

contents.what: static helpers sans(weight, spacing), display(weight, spacing, opsz), display_unique() (for tweening letter spacing), poster(), label(); cached FontVariations
Fraunces variable serif, wght 100-900, opsz 9-144, SOFT axis, Latin
Dela Gothic One, one heavy weight, Latin + kana + some kanji
SIL Open Font License 1.1 texts (must ship with the fonts)

scale: font sizes are pixels; the UI packs use a 1600x900 design canvas

verified.notes: Imported clean; demo.tscn rendered in Compatibility and Forward+ (identical); variable weights 200-800 / 100-900 visible; fresh project import + render clean, no script errors. Demo scripts re-show their own CanvasLayer every frame because the shelf capture tool hides UI layers between shots; harmless in a game. v1.1 (2026-10-03, owner rule: building blocks only): demo scene and demo scripts moved out; the remaining pieces are unchanged.
